overloadPatches.semanticRole: Inserts a picture passed directly as a Picture field/variable value (or a path string) into targetObj, and returns a reference to the inserted picture element.
Inserts a picture referenced by a 4D.File object or a path string (pictureFile) into targetObj, and returns a reference to the inserted picture element.

constraints: rangeUpdate is only honored when targetObj is a range; it is ignored if targetObj is an element or document.
If the picture value encapsulates several formats/codecs, 4D Write Pro keeps only one format for display and one for printing (best formats auto-selected).
